buzzRounds.topic: McDavid's season-opening point streak hits 19 games
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Connor McDavid scored the opening goal and Leon Draisaitl scored twice as the Edmonton Oilers beat the New York Rangers 3-1 on Monday, November 9. McDavid has now recorded a point in all 19 of Edmonton's games this season, making him the fourth player in NHL history with a 19-game season-opening point streak.
buzzRounds.whyCare: McDavid has 48 points during the streak (11 goals, 37 assists), and the last player to do it was Dany Heatley in 2005, when he ran it to 22 games.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Connor McDavid has had a point in all 19 Oilers games this season, 48 points in total, and only four players in NHL history have ever started a season that way.

details.name: Connor McDavid
details.buzz: McDavid extended his season-opening point streak to 19 games, with 48 points (11 goals, 37 assists) during the run.

details.name: Leon Draisaitl
details.buzz: Draisaitl scored twice against the Rangers, including an empty-net goal late in the third period, and has scored twice in consecutive games.

buzzRounds.topic: Hellebuyck blanks Toronto for his first shutout as a Devil
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves for his first shutout with the New Jersey Devils in a 4-0 win at the Toronto Maple Leafs on Sunday, November 8. Nico Hischier scored a power-play goal and added an assist. The Devils had acquired the goalie from the Winnipeg Jets on October 23.
buzzRounds.whyCare: The Devils are 13-5-0 and sit second in the Metropolitan Division in points, behind Carolina.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Connor Hellebuyck got his first shutout as a Devil on Sunday, stopping all 23 shots in a 4-0 win in Toronto, and New Jersey is 13-5-0.

buzzRounds.topic: Canadiens stretch their point streak to 10 games
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Montreal Canadiens beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 in Toronto on Saturday, November 7, with Alex Newhook scoring twice and rookie goalie Jacob Fowler making 26 saves. It was Montreal's fifth straight win over Toronto.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Montreal has earned a point in 10 straight games (8-0-2 in its last 10), and the 21-year-old Fowler is 8-1-1, the first rookie goalie aged 21 or younger with a nine-game point streak since Braden Holtby in 2010-11.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Canadiens haven't lost in regulation in 10 games, and their 21-year-old rookie goalie Jacob Fowler is 8-1-1 after beating Toronto 4-2 on Saturday.

details.buzz: Newhook scored both of his goals in the first period as Montreal beat Toronto for the fifth straight time.

buzzRounds.topic: Hurricanes score nine before flying to Finland
buzzRounds.whatHappened: The Carolina Hurricanes beat the Chicago Blackhawks 9-2 on Saturday, November 7, with Sebastian Aho scoring once and adding two assists. Alexander Nikishin scored in his season debut. Goalie Pyotr Kochetkov made 18 saves. Carolina now heads to Helsinki, Finland, to play the Seattle Kraken on November 12 and 14 in the NHL Global Series.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Carolina is 14-3-2, tops the league standings with 30 points, and has earned a point in 16 straight games against Chicago, the longest active streak against a single opponent in the NHL.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: The Hurricanes won 9-2 on Saturday, they lead the league with 30 points at 14-3-2, and now they fly to Finland to play two games against Seattle.

details.buzz: Aho had a goal and two assists in the 9-2 rout, as Carolina leads the NHL standings.
